display_name: Scene 13 shared interior (Jump House route)
evidence: Scene-2 event record 85 at 0x1730FC selects numeric field scene 13 after its separate entry page; event 30 in scene 13 selects Gunderson's dialogue profile. Puyallup scene-1 records 69/event 5 (Crime Mall), 72/event 3 (Riannon's), and 74/event 6 (Dr. Bob's) also load scene 13 without an entry page; FFFC1E bit 19 gates the same post-load actor list. The Jump House cross-reference does not name every incoming doorway, and these routes do not establish shop interactions.

display_name: The Wanderer (Scene 14 route)
